title: The pipeline report your team keeps asking for
goal: You will create a filtered and grouped opportunity pipeline report, chart it on a dashboard, and schedule dashboard emails to your team.
prerequisites: Salesforce access with report and dashboard creation permissions
Opportunity records containing Stage, Close Date, Amount, and Owner
A shared report folder and dashboard folder your team can access
Permission to add recipients to dashboard subscriptions

steps.where: Nine-dot App Launcher at the top-left of Salesforce, then the "View All" link and "Reports" item.
steps.why: The Reports workspace is where you create and manage Salesforce reports.
steps.checkpoint: The Reports tab is open and a "New Report" button is visible.
hint_levels: Start with the grid-shaped launcher at the top-left.
Open the full App Launcher and find Reports under All Items.
Click App Launcher > View All > Reports.

steps.action: Start a report using the Opportunities report type.
steps.where: "New Report" button, "Choose Report Type" window, and its search box.
steps.why: The report type determines which sales records and fields are available.
steps.checkpoint: Lightning Report Builder opens with an opportunity-record preview.
hint_levels: Look for the button near the upper-right of the Reports page.
Search the report-type window for Opportunities and select the basic Opportunities type.
Click New Report > search "Opportunities" > select Opportunities > Start Report.

steps.action: Set the report to include all opportunities closing in the current fiscal quarter.
steps.where: "Filters" tab in the left Details panel, using the "Show Me" and "Close Date" standard filters.
steps.why: These filters focus the report on the team's current-quarter pipeline.
steps.checkpoint: The Filters panel shows "Show Me: All opportunities" and a current-fiscal-quarter Close Date range.
hint_levels: Use the Filters tab beside Outline.
Edit the Show Me filter first, then edit the Close Date filter and choose the current fiscal quarter range.
Click Filters > Show Me > All opportunities > Apply, then Close Date > Range > Current FQ > Apply.

steps.action: Exclude closed opportunities with a Stage filter.
steps.where: "Filters" tab in the left Details panel and the "Add Filter" search box.
steps.why: Removing won and lost deals leaves only active pipeline.
steps.checkpoint: A Stage filter appears in the Filters panel and the preview no longer shows Closed Won or Closed Lost records.
hint_levels: Add one more filter below the standard filters.
Choose Stage, use the not-equal operator, and exclude both closed stage values available in your organization.
Click Filters > Add Filter > Stage > operator "not equal to" > select Closed Won and Closed Lost > Apply.

steps.action: Group the report rows by Stage.
steps.where: "Outline" tab in the left Details panel, under "Groups" and "Group Rows".
steps.why: Stage grouping shows how much pipeline sits at each point in the sales process.
steps.checkpoint: The preview is divided into labeled Stage sections with subtotals.
hint_levels: Move from Filters back to Outline and look under Groups.
Use the Group Rows field selector and choose Stage.
Click Outline > Group Rows > Add group > Stage.

steps.action: Group each stage by Opportunity Owner.
steps.why: The second grouping reveals each salesperson's contribution within every stage.
steps.checkpoint: Owner names appear as nested groups beneath the Stage groups in the preview.
hint_levels: Add another row grouping below Stage.
Choose Opportunity Owner as the second Group Rows field.
Click Outline > Group Rows > Add group > Opportunity Owner.

steps.action: Summarize the Amount column by sum.
steps.where: Report preview, dropdown arrow in the "Amount" column header, then the "Summarize" menu.
steps.why: Summing Amount turns the grouped records into measurable pipeline totals.
steps.checkpoint: Each group displays an Amount subtotal and the report displays a grand total.
hint_levels: Open the menu attached to the Amount heading.
The Summarize submenu contains the aggregation choices for numeric fields.
Click the Amount column arrow > Summarize > Sum.

steps.action: Add a horizontal bar chart showing summed Amount by Stage.
steps.where: "Add Chart" button above the report preview and the chart "Properties" gear panel.
steps.why: A chart makes stage-by-stage pipeline differences easy to scan.
steps.checkpoint: A horizontal bar chart appears above the table with Stage labels and Amount values.
hint_levels: Use the chart control above the preview after confirming the report is grouped.
Add the chart, open Chart Properties, choose Horizontal Bar, Stage, and Sum of Amount.
Click Add Chart > Properties gear > Display As: Horizontal Bar > Y-Axis: Stage > X-Axis: Sum of Amount.

steps.action: Save and run the report as "Current Quarter Pipeline by Stage and Owner" in your team's shared report folder.
steps.where: "Save & Run" button at the upper-right and the "Save Report" dialog.
steps.why: Saving in a shared folder makes the report available as a dashboard source.
steps.checkpoint: The completed report page opens with its name displayed at the top.
hint_levels: Finish the report from the upper-right corner.
In the save dialog, enter the report name and select a report folder your team can view.
Click Save & Run > enter "Current Quarter Pipeline by Stage and Owner" > Select Folder > choose the shared report folder > Select Folder > Save.

steps.action: Create a dashboard named "Team Pipeline Dashboard" in your team's shared dashboard folder.
steps.where: "Dashboards" tab in the Salesforce navigation bar, "New Dashboard" button, and "New Dashboard" dialog.
steps.why: The dashboard provides a shared home for the pipeline visualization.
steps.checkpoint: Dashboard Builder opens with "Team Pipeline Dashboard" at the top and an empty canvas.
hint_levels: Leave the report page and open the Dashboards workspace.
Start a new dashboard, give it the requested name, and choose the team's shared dashboard folder.
Click Dashboards > New Dashboard > enter "Team Pipeline Dashboard" > Select Folder > choose the shared folder > Select Folder > Create.

steps.action: Add the saved pipeline report as a dashboard chart widget and save the dashboard.
steps.where: Dashboard Builder toolbar, "+ Widget" button, "Select Report" window, widget editor, and "Save" button.
steps.why: The widget places the live report totals on the shared dashboard.
steps.checkpoint: The saved dashboard canvas shows a chart populated from "Current Quarter Pipeline by Stage and Owner".
hint_levels: Add a widget sourced from the report you just saved.
Choose the pipeline report, keep a bar chart visualization, add it to the canvas, and save.
Click + Widget > Chart or Table > search for and select "Current Quarter Pipeline by Stage and Owner" > Select > choose Horizontal Bar if needed > Add > Save.

steps.action: Subscribe your team to receive the refreshed dashboard on the requested schedule.
steps.where: Dashboard viewing page, "Subscribe" button, "Edit Subscription" dialog, and "Edit Recipients" control.
steps.why: The subscription automatically refreshes and emails the dashboard on a predictable cadence.
steps.checkpoint: A confirmation appears and the Subscribe dialog shows the saved frequency, time, and recipients.
hint_levels: Open the subscription control on the finished dashboard.
Choose the team's requested frequency and time, add permitted recipients, and leave email delivery enabled.
Click Done if needed > Subscribe > set Frequency, Day, and Time > Edit Recipients > select each user, group, or role > Add > Close > keep "Receive new results by email" selected > Save.
